announcements.headline: Post-Stabilization Notice ING Bank
announcements.insight: The post-stabilization notice follows earlier pre-stabilization filings from September and November. This indicates the completion of a stabilization period for ING Bank N.V.

announcements.headline: Post-stabilization Notice ING Bank
announcements.insight: ING Bank N.V. has concluded its stabilization activities following earlier notices in September and November 2026.

announcements.headline: Pre-Stabilization Notice_INGBank N.V
announcements.insight: ING Bank N.V. issued a second pre-stabilization notice in November 2026, following an earlier filing in September 2026.

announcements.headline: Pre-StabilizationNotice_INGBank
announcements.insight: ING Bank N.V. issued a pre-stabilization notice following its earlier filing in September 2026. Shareholders should monitor subsequent announcements for details on any potential market support activities.

announcements.headline: Pre-stabilization Notice - ING Bank N.V.
announcements.insight: ING Bank N.V. has issued a pre-stabilization notice. Shareholders should monitor subsequent filings for details on any potential market support activities.
